## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. SPY in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) and VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) give mixed risk signals while HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%) and LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%) reflect rising credit stress.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear edging up: VXX (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%) ↑ rising in RECOVERY. Stocks vs Bonds remains bullish: SPY/TLT ratio (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +9.47%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while credit spread (HYG/LQD 1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.45%) → flat ABOVE TREND signals tightening credit conditions.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-tighter conditions: TLT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +0.25%) and Breakeven inflation steady (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.49%) → flat ABOVE TREND; Dollar strength (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.19%) → flat RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Tech-led: XLK in ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX in ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%) showing outsized strength; Financials in CORRECTION (XLF proxy 1W: -2.23% | 1M: +5.83%) showing near-term weakness. Style: Growth/Momentum showing leadership but breadth is narrow.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US holding up: SPY in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.70%) vs EEM in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +11.01%); China mixed with FXI in CORRECTION (1W: -1.97% | 1M: +2.39%) and KWEB BELOW TREND (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -1.06%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Selective risk-on: IWM in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +9.86%) and IBIT in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.18% | 1M: +9.58%) show appetite, while ARKK in CORRECTION (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +9.44%) signals short-term profit-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Energy and base industrials mixed: BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%) and CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +9.32%) outperform, while Gold (GLD) in CORRECTION (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%) is seeing profit-taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy bifurcated: XLE in RECOVERY (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -6.11%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%), while Natural Gas UNG is BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
Confirmed: XLK and SOXX both timeframes positive (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%); SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%)). Divergence: material 1W vs 1M mismatches across XLF (CORRECTION), TLT (CORRECTION) and VXX (RECOVERY) — a MAJOR divergence that mutes conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor Growth/Momentum exposure (XLK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%), QQQ (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +12.94%), SOXX (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%)) while reducing exposure to defensive and idiosyncratic weakness in Healthcare (XLV BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%)) and China tech (KWEB BELOW TREND (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -1.06%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Technology / Semiconductors — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%).  
BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary in short-term pullbacks — XLV BELOW TREND (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -1.41%) and XLY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +7.19%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Oil exposure via BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.66% | 1M: +7.83%).  
BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.89% | 1M: -13.07%) and gold GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +4.07%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VIX/VXX watch: VIX level 29.79 (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -18.65%) and VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.80% | 1M: -13.02%); HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7343 (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +0.45%) signals credit stress; Tech vs Financials ratio XLK/XLF at 3.1159 (1W: +6.10% | 1M: +15.35%) is a leadership pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and Semiconductors showing strength — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +17.15%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.04% | 1M: +33.70%).  
Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +1.83%), LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +1.21%)) and MAJOR divergence across XLF (CORRECTION), TLT (CORRECTION) and VXX (RECOVERY) that tempers conviction.
